title: In silico and RT-qPCR analysis of the 8q22.2 region in muscle invasive bladder cancer
author: Daniel Uysal
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bmewk3fe
materials: CN, mRNA and clinical data download

Relative quantification of mRNA expression of COX6C , OSR2 and the reference gene CALM2 was measured on a StepOnePlus Real-Time PCR system (Life Technologies, Karlsbad, California, USA) with the SuperScript III Platinum One-Step quantitative RT-PCR system (Invitrogen, Karlsruhe, Germany) using Taqman FAST advanced master Mix (Life Technologies Corporation, Austin, Texas, USA). RT-qPCR was performed at an annealing temperature of 60°C using the Taqman FAST protocol on the StepOnePlus Real-Time PCR system with 95°C for 20 seconds, followed by 95°C for 3 seconds and finally, 60°C for 30 seconds. Further information can be found in the respective instruction manuals: (StepOnePlus Real-Time PCR system: https://www.thermofisher.com/document-connect/document-connect.html?url=https%3A%2F%2Fassets.thermofisher.com%2FTFS-Assets%2FLSG%2Fmanuals%2Fcms_046736.pdf&title=QUIgU3RlcE9uZSBhbmQgU3RlcE9uZVBsdXMgUmVhbC1UaW1lIFBDUiBTeXN0ZW1zIC0gUmVsYXRpdmUgU3RhbmRhcmQgQ3VydmUgYW5kIENvbXBhcmF0aXZlIENUIEV4cGVyaW1lbnRz , https://www.thermofisher.com/document-connect/document-connect.html?url=https%3A%2F%2Fassets.thermofisher.com%2FTFS-Assets%2FLSG%2Fmanuals%2Fcms_046739.pdf&title=TWFudWFsOiBBQiBTdGVwT25lIGFuZCBTdGVwT25lUGx1cyBSZWFsLXRpbWUgUENSIFN5c3RlbXMgLSBSZWFnZW50IEd1aWRl , SuperScript III Platinum One-Step quantitative RT-PCR system: https://www.thermofisher.com/document-connect/document-connect.html?url=https%3A%2F%2Fassets.thermofisher.com%2FTFS-Assets%2FLSG%2Fmanuals%2Fsuperscript_onestep_qrtpcr_man.pdf&title=UHJvZHVjdCBJbmZvIFNoZWV0OiBTdXBlclNjcmlwdCBJSUkgUGxhdGludW0gT25lLVN0ZXAgcVJULVBDUiBLaXQ= , Taqman FAST advanced master Mix: https://assets.thermofisher.com/TFS-Assets/LSG/manuals/cms_084554.pdf ).

steps.title: Access cBioPortal and select study
steps.instruction: Open https://www.cbioportal.org/, choose the Bladder Cancer (TCGA, Cell 2017) study.

steps.title: Download CNA and mRNA data
steps.instruction: In the selected study, download putative copy‑number alterations from GISTIC and mRNA expression z‑scores (values 1, 2, 3) for the case set that includes mutation data (n=402). Enter the following 8q22.2 genes: RNF19A, SPAG1, RGS22, POLR2K, FBXO43, COX6C, VPS13B, STK3, OSR2, KCNS2, RPL30, RIDA, POP1, NIPAL2, ERICH5.

steps.title: Download clinical data
steps.instruction: Click the pie‑chart symbol next to the Bladder Cancer (TCGA, Cell 2017) study to select clinical data.

steps.title: Import and merge data files
steps.instruction: Download all selected data as .txt files, import them into JMP SAS 14.0, and merge the clinical, CNA, and mRNA files into a single dataset.

steps.title: Open XENA browser for mutations
steps.instruction: Navigate to https://xenabrowser.net/ and select the mutations dataset.

steps.title: Apply exclusion criteria to dataset
steps.instruction: Remove any samples that received neoadjuvant chemotherapy, have unknown tumor stage (Tx), or lack a defined tumor stage.

steps.title: Generate oncoprint visualization
steps.instruction: Copy the remaining sample IDs, paste them into the “Select patient set” field on cBioPortal, and generate an oncoprint.

steps.title: Create Excel sheet for survival data
steps.instruction: In a new Excel workbook, copy and paste the columns “Overall Survival (Months)”, “OS Zensor (1=living)”, and each amplicon column (DNA_Amplicon_Core, RNA_Amplicon_Core, DNA_Amplicon_Ext1, DNA_Amplicon_Ext2).

steps.title: Filter amplified cases and adjust OS column
steps.instruction: For each amplicon column, apply a filter to show only amplified (AMP) cases, delete the corresponding rows in the OS Zensor column, then clear the filter.

steps.title: Prepare survival data in Prism
steps.instruction: Open GraphPad Prism 8.0, paste the “Overall Survival (Months)” column, then paste the edited OS Zensor column (with AMP cases removed) beside it and name the new column DNA_NONAMP_Core.

steps.title: Repeat for non‑amplified cases
steps.instruction: Perform the same Prism import for the NONAMP rows of each amplicon column, creating appropriately named columns.

steps.title: Repeat for other amplicon columns
steps.instruction: Apply the filtering, Excel copying, and Prism import steps to the remaining amplicon columns (RNA_Amplicon_Core, DNA_Amplicon_Ext1, DNA_Amplicon_Ext2).

steps.title: Extract RNA from FFPE slides
steps.instruction: Using 10 µm thick formalin‑fixed, paraffin‑embedded tissue slides, extract RNA with the bead‑based XTRAKT FFPE kit (Xtract® kit; STRATIFYER Molecular Pathology GmbH, Cologne, Germany) following the kit’s instruction manual.
